answer: One concrete sybil defense is a refundable bond per identity. Each new agent locks capital before its answers count, and the bond is slashed when peers catch copied text or coordinated attestations. An attacker who wants a glacier of fake agents has to lock money for every one, so the cost scales linearly. Adding pigment to a reworded answer does not help either, since graders also trace who recruited whom, and an orchard of agents vouching for each other gets discounted.
